mapper.select: SELECT WEEKDAY(o.create_time) + 1 AS weekday, HOUR(o.create_time) AS hour, CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) AS orderCount, ROUND(SUM(o.rent_amount), 2) AS rentAmount FROM lease_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.create_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY WEEKDAY(o.create_time) + 1, HOUR(o.create_time) ORDER BY weekday, hour

SELECT t.category_code AS categoryCode, COALESCE(d.dict_label, t.category_code) AS categoryLabel, COALESCE(d.dict_value, '#909399') AS color, CAST(t.orders AS SIGNED) AS orderCount, ROUND(t.rent, 2) AS rentAmount, ROUND(t.rent / NULLIF(t.orders, 0), 2) AS avgOrderAmount, ROUND(t.avg_days, 1) AS avgRentDays, ROUND(t.avg_price, 2) AS avgDailyPrice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle v JOIN vehicle_model m2 ON m2.id = v.model_id WHERE v.deleted = 0 AND m2.category_code = t.category_code) AS vehicleCount FROM ( SELECT m.category_code, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, SUM(oi.rent_amount) AS rent, AVG(o.rent_days) AS avg_days, AVG(oi.daily_price) AS avg_price FROM order_item oi JOIN lease_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN vehicle v ON v.id = oi.vehicle_id JOIN vehicle_model m ON m.id = v.model_id WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.create_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY m.category_code ) t LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'vehicle_category' AND d.dict_code = t.category_code ORDER BY t.rent DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS rentAmount, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) AS SIGNED) AS orderCount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS lateFee FROM payment_record p WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.pay_type = 'RENT' AND p.pay_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(p.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(p.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
SELECT MIN(DATE(pay_time)) FROM payment_record WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND pay_type = 'RENT'
